title: UnitDestroyed
description: A unit is lost (CONTRACTS §6; STATE-MACHINES §4.1 Destroyed). Produced by fuel exhaustion (NX-368) and a captured base (NX-125), both with killer null and no assists, and by combat (NX-124): killer is the shooter of the killing hit and the assists are the other shooters that hit the unit within combat.assist_window_s. Public view: a hidden killer becomes null (FOW-3); a hidden victim is dropped.

killer_id.description: null: no killer (fuel exhaustion or loss of a captured base), or a hidden killer in the public view.

assist_ids.description: Combat: the other shooters that hit the unit within combat.assist_window_s, sorted, no duplicates (producer). Not uniqueItems: that generates a set, whose order is not deterministic (SC-14).
